messages:
maya (pm): quick heads-up: customer asked for a private pilot starting next month. need minimal launch criteria and owners.
leo (eng-platform): we can scope a slim pilot: 1 model variant, 2 staging slots, canary + fallback. need infra and security signoff.
omar (infra): 2x A100 commit possible for pilot week but need exact dates and vpc peering ticket. will require prewarm plan (cost note).
rachel (security): primary blocker is KMS/HSM onboarding + dataflow. if we get diagrams today i can target review in 3 business days.
nina (runtime): runtime will run 48h perf sweeps after model pin. need pinned sha and a 5k-message traffic sample. can also provide a quant profile to lower latency.
dave (eng-sre): ill own canary + rollback playbook. recommend an auto-fallback to hosted model for the canary to limit customer-visible errors. need SLOs from product.
maya (pm): proposed minimal SLOs for pilot: 250ms p95, 99.8% availability. owners: model pin (prod/ml), perf run (runtime), staging smoke (eng-platform), infra slot (infra), KMS review (security), canary/runbook (eng-sre).
leo (eng-platform): ack. will produce smoke test steps and rollback checklist by Mon 1718380000.
omar (infra): creating ticket now -> https://redwood.example.com/ticket/PI-4999. adding vpc, peering, egress, and prewarm options.
rachel (security): dropping checklist in ticket. please attach minimal dataflow and sample PII mapping.
nina (runtime): will upload perf harness and sample dataset to the ticket once model sha is provided.
dave (eng-sre): drafting runbook. also adding alert thresholds and a simple play to flip fallback if p95 > 400ms during canary.
customer-success-bot: customer notified of pilot SLO proposal; awaiting acceptance.
maya (pm): thanks all. quick ask: react :thumbsup: to own items, or call out risks. well regroup Wed 15:00 for status.
leo (eng-platform): :thumbsup:
omar (infra): :thumbsup:
rachel (security): :thumbsup:
nina (runtime): :thumbsup:
dave (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
